	table = None

	  extraction_metadata = json.loads(Extraction_Metadata)

	  sheets = json.loads(context['document_text'])
	  for sheet in sheets:
	    if extraction_metadata[1]["Value"] == sheet["name"]:
	      table = sheet["table"]
	      break
	
	  if not table:

	except:
	  return res

	table = table[extraction_metadata[0]["Value"]:]

	  return res

	  col_indices.append(header.index(extraction_metadata[idx]["Value"]))
	
	df1 = pandas.DataFrame(table, columns = header)
	df1 = df1[[header[idx] for idx in col_indices]]
	
	df1["severity"] = df1["Likelihood"].map(lambda x: re.findall(r'\((.*?)\)', x)).map(lambda x: x[-1] if x else '')

	df1["service_name"] = df1["Scan_Source_UID"].map(lambda x: x.split(":")[0].split("/")[-1])
	df1["package_name"] = df1["Title"]
	df1["fixed_version"] = df1["Solution"].map(lambda x: re.findall(r"SOLUTION:(.*)", x[-50:])).map(lambda x: x[0] if x else '')
	df1["package_installed_version"] = df1["Title"].map(lambda x: x.split(":")).map(lambda x: x[-1] if len(x) > 1 else '')
	
	df = []
	for idx, row in df1.iterrows():
	    for cve in row["CVE"].split():
	        df.append([cve, row["severity"], row["release_version"], row["service_name"], row["package_name"], row["fixed_version"], row["package_installed_version"]])
	
	df = pandas.DataFrame(df, columns = columns)
	return df.to_dict('records')
